boundary: Actual SpriteContents(FrameSize,NativeImage) and TextureAtlasSprite constructor/getters/getU/getV. Scalar direct fixtures use a1x1 opaque CPU image with supplied FrameSize, intentionally distinct from image dimensions; eight resources decode actual pinned PNGs. Five scenes use actual Stitcher callbacks directly. No animation metadata, mipmap generation, GPU upload, UBO execution or final frame.
